title: Nonlinear stability of 3-D plane Couette flow for Boussinesq system in a finite channel
summary: In this paper, we study the hydrodynamics stability of the 3-D plane Couette flow $v_s=(y,0,0)$ with constant temperature state $ρ_s$ for the Boussinesq system in a finite channel $\mathbb{T}\times [-1,1]\times \mathbb{T}$ with non-slip boundary condition in $y$ direction. We prove that if the initial velocity field $v_{in}$ and initial temperature $ρ_{in}$ satisfy \begin{align*} \|v_{in}-(y,0,0)\|_{H^2} \leq c_0 ν, \ \ \|ρ_{in}-ρ_s\|_{H^2} \leq c_0 ν^2, \end{align*} for some $c_0>0$ independent of the viscosity and thermal diffusion $ν$, then the solutions to 3D Boussinesq system do not…
